item.description: Robert Woodyard Jr. forced a pair of turnovers in the third quarter, allowing the Tigers to capitalize with 14 points in under a minute to pull away in an emotional rivalry win.

item.title: New quarterbacks for Mizzou, Kansas face first major tests
item.description: The starting signal callers for both Mizzou and Kansas will be under the microscope in the Week One showdown.
